notes: V6 open work: each proposal is text only and review-gated.
Blocking severities present (critical/high), so the verdict is attention_required.

evidence: the forbidden-tool list is enforced but only covered indirectly
a regression would hand an agent exec/network tools with no test to catch it
proposals.rationale: no test pins the invariant that no actor or role (admin included) can widen the tool set past the gate's forbidden list, so a future role or bootstrap change could silently reopen docker.exec, terminal.run, api.call or search.web on the agent path
proposals.title: Fix tools/gateway: the forbidden-tool list is enforced but only covered indirectly

proposals.rationale: scopes are isolated in MemoryProvider, but no test writes to one scope and asserts a read from another scope cannot see it
proposals.title: prove scope isolation with an explicit cross-scope read attempt

evidence: bounds are implemented but edge cases are untested
an off-by-one or a missed deadline check would make the loop unbounded
proposals.rationale: max_iterations, max_wall_clock_seconds and step_timeout_seconds are enforced in loop.py, yet no test drives the exact boundary (last allowed iteration, deadline reached mid-step, a hung step cut off)
proposals.title: Fix autonomy/loop: bounds are implemented but edge cases are untested

proposals.rationale: results are emitted in plan order and the first error is chosen deterministically; a concurrency change could reorder them unnoticed
proposals.title: lock deterministic ordering of parallel-level results

evidence: loop-safety regression is not guarded by a test
a reintroduced cached client breaks the AI path on the second live request
proposals.rationale: providers must not cache an httpx.AsyncClient in __init__; the Telegram webhook builds and closes a fresh event loop per request, so a cached client fails on the second request with 'Event loop is closed'
proposals.title: Fix providers: loop-safety regression is not guarded by a test

proposals.rationale: a member failing is expected and must never fail the deliberation; BEST, VOTE and SYNTHESIS each need a test with one dead member
proposals.title: cover a failing council member in every strategy

evidence: secret redaction is asserted for memory but not for the ledgers
a token could land in a durable ledger file
proposals.rationale: decisions and failures are persisted to disk; a secret embedded in a reason or an evidence string must be redacted before it is written
proposals.title: Fix transparency/ledger: secret redaction is asserted for memory but not for the ledgers
